thread:
alex: quick async standup for gateway/routing/auth/rate limits — what I did / blockers / today

maya: did: merged PR for route-affinity + added a flaky test fix. saw some 429s in staging last night.

sasha: blocked: can't reproduce 429s locally, need more staging logs. pinged @tom to share load profile.

tom: did: ran load job @ 500rps for 10m against staging, saw tail latencies spike at ~95th after KV cache miss.

alex: action: i'll add a short-lived prefix cache in front of canary and re-run. also PTAL @maya on the canary config (rate windows).

maya: did: adjusted canary throttle from 1000rps -> 750rps and enabled burst smoothing. pushed config to staging: `configs/gateway/canary-2026-03-17.yaml`

alex: snippet of the smoothing I added:

```
throttle: 
  target_rps: 750
  burst: 150
  smoothing_window_ms: 500
```

jordan: FYI: if smoothing_window_ms < 200 it's noisy on nvlink under contention, keep >= 300 for dedicated pools.

ci-bot: canary-deploy: staging-canary-7 passed smoke checks, rollout at 20% complete :white_check_mark:

sasha: tonight: i'll grab the staging trace dump and grep for auth path latencies, will share a small trace. also can take the review for the route-affinity PR.

tom: today: help sasha reproduce with a synthetic KV miss pattern, and I'll watch autoscaler for burst behavior.

alex: blockers: none blocking deploy now, but need 1 reviewer for the affinity PR and someone to sanity-check the smoothing params.

maya: i can review in next 30m. also propose adding a short smoke test that injects KV miss to catch regressions.

alex: agreed. plan: maya reviews, sasha runs trace dump + smoke test, tom runs load with prefix cache enabled. i'll monitor telemetry and rollback if 5xx/429 rate > 1% in 15m.

sasha: +1. leaving a note in the PR: "test: staging-smoke-kv-miss" and linking this thread.

alex: thanks all :thumbsup: if anything spikes, @channel alert and i'll jump in.
